CCP-Export.label: Clinical Data (Export Files)
CCP-Export.description: Provide sites with the ability to export pseudonymized datasets in tabular file formats, which are directly shared with researchers by the site. This approach gives sites full responsibility and control over the data-sharing process.

CUSTOM.label: Custom
CUSTOM.description: Offer a highly configurable export service tailored to advanced users. Researchers can customize export templates, select output formats, and define various parameters to suit specific project needs. This service is ideal for users with in-depth technical knowledge and complex requirements.
